title: Ultra Grand Slam Fishing

services.name: Full Day Charter
services.desc: It Is Not A Fish Until It Is On The Bank! Duration Eight Hours About Ride in comfort aboard the largest charter boat on charter boat row. Captain Magnus has over 20 years fishing in the water of South Florida and Key West. Let him take you on a Fishing Trip catching (((BIG))) Fish, and making memories of a lifetime! It is not uncommon for anglers on other charters to be fishing while angles aboard the Ultra Grand Slam are catching. And, that’s where the fun is! If you are looking for the thrill of bringing in a fish that’s as big as you then you are in the right place! All Ages! What to Bring Sunscreen Sunglasses Hat Snacks/Picnic Lunch Anything to drink besides water Mask Your good luck
